sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was explicitly reduced: Q3 revenues expected down low double digits, gross margins down 300-350 bps, and a greater headwind in Q4 vs Q3. Management acknowledged that near-term actions (inventory liquidation, shifting to full-price model, reducing performance marketing) will result in lower revenue, additional gross margin pressure, and higher demand creation expenses. The CEO stated 'some of these actions will have a negative impact on our near-term results.' This constitutes a clear guidance reduction relative to prior expectations.

summary.revenue: Q2 revenues were $12.4 billion, down 8% on a reported basis and down 9% on a currency-neutral basis.
summary.eps: Diluted EPS was $0.78, a decrease of 24% from $1.03 in the prior year.
summary.guidance: Q3 revenues expected down low double digits; Q3 gross margins down approximately 300 to 350 basis points; Q3 SG&A dollars slightly down year over year; greater headwind in Q4 compared to Q3; summer '25 order books down versus prior year.
summary.margin: Gross margin decreased 100 basis points to 43.6%.
key_risks: Higher markdowns and promotional activity on NIKE Direct and wholesale discounts to liquidate inventory.
Channel mix headwinds pressuring gross margins.
Inventory levels higher than desired, especially given recent sales trends on NIKE Direct.
Near-term revenue, gross margin, and demand creation headwinds from strategic repositioning actions.
Greater China macro environment challenging with retail traffic declines and higher markdown activity.
key_opportunities: Returning sport to the center of everything, with sport-led 'fields of play' teams (running, basketball, training, football, sportswear).
Rebuilding wholesale partner relationships and earning back shelf space with innovative product.
Shifting NIKE Digital to a full-price model to improve profitability over time.
Investing in brand marketing and sports marketing to drive organic demand.
New product pipeline for fall/holiday '25 including Vomero 18, Pegasus Premium, and strong basketball lineup.
Long-term sport partnership extensions (NBA, WNBA, NFL, Brazil Football Confederation, FC Barcelona).
